title: Vanilla no more
description: A big modpack aiming at giving you a huge variety of things to do.
body:
#### Currently in Beta
### Vanilla no more is a large modpack that aims to give you a huge variety of activities in your Minecraft world.
There is no specific goal other than providing numerous options throughout the game and improving your immersion.
This modpack contains unique terrain and structure generation mods for all Dimension, some quality of life mods, performance mods, texture and shader packs which complement the contained mods and many more.
I don't want to give much away. Try it out yourself i think its very fun.

##### Logo Source: https://de.vecteezy.com/kostenloses-png/mathematik Logo Owner: Vecteezy
